description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git mergetool' functionality, including setup, various test cases for merging conflicts, submodules, configuration options, and tool integrations in Git.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that must succeed; runs setup, commands, and verifies outcomes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail; used for testing error conditions.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Schedules cleanup commands to run after test completion.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or verifies specific Git configuration settings for the test.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Helper to write lines to files for test setup.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares file contents to expected output.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Greps through output for specific patterns.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a command’s output is empty.
